submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 with a 38 GeV threshold. All three candidate algorithms are Level-1 deployable, and the selected threshold is within the allowed 20–60 GeV range. Among the evaluated operating points, Algorithm-L3 at 38 GeV gives the highest recorded signal efficiency, 93.691%, exceeding the best coarse scan point of Algorithm-L3 at 30 GeV with 91.415% and all refined Algorithm-L1 comparison points. This is therefore the best available choice for maximizing signal efficiency under the stated selection constraints; the allocated trigger rate is recorded as 8 kHz, but no explicit selected-point rate value was included in the recorded results.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The selected point, Algorithm-L3 at 38 GeV, has the highest recorded efficiency in the scans: 93.691%. The allocated rate is recorded as 8 kHz; no explicit rate-at-threshold value was recorded, but this point was selected by the prior optimization results as selected_algorithm_code=3, selected_threshold_gev=38, selected_efficiency_pct=93.691.
